name: houndarr
description: Houndarr is a self-hosted companion for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and Whisparr that schedules missing, cutoff-unmet, and optional upgrade searches in small, rate-limited batches. It triggers searches through your *arr apps but does not download media, manage indexers, or modify files.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and master key. Back this up.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Houndarr web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file ownership inside the container.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file ownership inside the container.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true when running behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS termination.

variables.name: Trusted Proxies
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted reverse-proxy IPs or CIDR subnets for X-Forwarded-For (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16). Required for accurate rate limiting behind a proxy.

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: Authentication mode: builtin (default) or proxy (delegate auth to reverse proxy/SSO).

variables.name: Auth Proxy Header
variables.description: Username header from reverse proxy in proxy mode (for example Remote-User). Required when Auth Mode is proxy.

variables.name: Log Retention Days
variables.description: Days of search log rows Houndarr keeps before the daily retention sweep deletes older entries. 0 disables automatic purges; 7 to 365 overrides the default. Lower this if the dashboard feels slow on a long-running instance.
